hooks.name: Verify Backend & Rebuild Ledger Template
hooks.description: When a Python file in src/backend/ or scripts/build_ledger.py is saved, run the full pytest suite and, only if it passes, regenerate Midnight_Audit_1928_Template.xlsx.

action.command: uv run --with-requirements requirements-dev.txt python -m pytest -q && uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/build_ledger.py
